note: No spec can override these. An exception needs approvals[gate=exception] in Krish's words.

invariants.rule: Every cut carries burned-in house captions
invariants.enforced_by: schema brand.captions literal 'house'; BrandFrame always draws CaptionTrack

invariants.rule: On the 16:9 cut, mark tile on every beat and channel pill on the section beat; on the 9:16 cut no mark tile, pill, wordmark or series tag over the animated beats, the closing outro keeping the wordmark (Ruling, Krish, 2026-11-11); grain behind
invariants.enforced_by: FormatMaster wraps every beat in BrandFrame; qc_brand.mark_tile on 16:9 and qc_brand.no_mark on 9:16; engine.test.ts

invariants.rule: Specs and devices name colour roles, never hex
invariants.enforced_by: lint brand.no_hex; ESLint no-raw-hex in apps/renderer/src/engine

invariants.rule: Picture is never retimed apart from its audio; one EDL drives picture, dialogue, bed, SFX and captions in one render
invariants.enforced_by: FormatMaster + clock.ts; no mux path in ve

invariants.rule: No per-piece compositions or render scripts
Evidence is never generated, and a generated picture never stands in for a real place, record or test; it carries no ILLUSTRATION tag (Krish, 28 Oct 2026)

No cut shows a dated prediction: no call card, no due date, no confidence. It replaces INV-DATED-CALL (mind.the.gap ends in a dated call), retired on 2026-11-18; a mind.the.gap cut names the pattern and where it leads
invariants.enforced_by: compile never writes props.call and ignores a spec's retired call; the renderer has no call card (CallCard removed, BrandFrame draws a retired call beat like any beat); lint asks for no call beat; tests/ve.test.ts and apps/renderer/src/engine/engine.test.ts
invariants.ruling: Krish 2026-11-17: "I don't do dated-and-scored make-your-mind-up pieces because it felt quite tacky and gimmicky. I don't really have the clout such that my opinion can hold up in official scores." Krish 2026-11-18: "get rid of that - i have abandoned the prediction format, it feels lame"

invariants.rule: Every number on screen names whoever produced it

No word on screen names Krish: not his name, a spelling or handle of it, or a possessive of it, and another person called Krish is blocked too. A test the publication ran is labelled OUR TEST · <date>. His face appears; his name never does
invariants.enforced_by: lint brand.no_name (copy-lint no_name, over the spec's public words only)
invariants.ruling: Krish 2026-10-28: "Remember, no content refers to Krish, ever. I still see that popping up from time to time. Even articles written are not authored by Krish. My face only, for assets and the video format." Krish picked: "Yes, block it" (D4, other people called Krish)

invariants.rule: No synthetic Krish (HeyGen avatar, voice clone) until Krish approves a realism test
invariants.ruling: Krish 2026-10-27: on backup until trained and convincing

invariants.rule: ve has no publish verb; agents never publish, send or schedule
Readiness is computed from qc.json bound to the mp4 sha, the Critic verdict and Krish's approvals; no agent writes a pass
